business_summary:
Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides big data, artificial intelligence, and digital marketing solutions in the People's Republic of China. The company provides marketing intelligence platform; real-time marketing platform for real-time events, such as customer transaction/browsing behavior, function activation; personalized recommendation system to manage and operate content recommendations on mobile apps or other online channel; tag management system, which integrates tag construction, operation, and management; and marketing content management system to achieve one-stop management of marketing content. It also offers user portrait systems to help business/analysts of financial institutions; interpretable machine learning solutions for financial industry; automated machine learning solutions; intelligent anti-fraud solutions; and credit risk warning plan. In addition, it provides enterprise-level data platform; real-time analysis and calculation platform; data warehouse; data management and control platform; data lake platform that allows structured and unstructured data to be stored at any scale; and regulatory reporting platform. Further, the company offers artificial intelligence products; model management platform, and panoramic regulatory compliance; and marketing automation, event marketing, personalized recommendation, user profiling, MGM customer acquisition system, and customer micro-segmentation. Additionally, it sells software and hardware products; and offers professional consulting, and information technology maintenance and support services, as well as trading of commodities and cryptocurrencies mining. The company has strategic cooperation agreement with Wanel Capital Limited to carry out research, communication and digital ecosystem
building. The company was formerly known as Suoxinda Holdings Limited and changed its name to Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited in October 2023. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 빅데이터, 인공지능, 디지털 마케팅 솔루션을 제공합니다. 회사는 마케팅 인텔리전스 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 고객 거래/탐색 행위, 기능 활성화 등 실시간 이벤트를 위한 실시간 마케팅 플랫폼; 모바일 앱이나 기타 온라인 채널에서 콘텐츠 추천을 관리 및 운영하기 위한 개인화된 추천 시스템; 태그 구축, 운영, 관리를 통합한 태그 관리 시스템; 마케팅 콘텐츠를 원스톱으로 관리할 수 있는 마케팅 콘텐츠 관리 시스템입니다. 또한 금융 기관의 비즈니스/분석가를 돕기 위한 사용자 초상화 시스템을 제공합니다. 금융 산업을 위한 해석 가능한 기계 학습 솔루션; 자동화된 기계 학습 솔루션; 지능형 사기 방지 솔루션; 신용 위험 경고 계획. 또한 기업 수준의 데이터 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 실시간 분석 및 계산 플랫폼; 데이터 웨어하우스; 데이터 관리 및 제어 플랫폼; 정형 및 비정형 데이터를 어떤 규모로든 저장할 수 있는 데이터 레이크 플랫폼 규제 보고 플랫폼입니다. 푸르트
